record.field: Upload files into Odoo attachments and download them by attachment_id; bytes never travel through the MCP channel.

The `attachment_*` tools move files in and out of `ir.attachment`. The `attachment_id` returned by these tools is an attachment id and the only safe cross-tool reference for a file.
Upload 1. `attachment_stage_upload(filename)` -> `attachment_id` plus a temporary upload URL. 2. `curl -T <file> '<url>'` — the bytes go straight to the URL, not through the tool channel. 3. `attachment_commit_upload(attachment_id, res_model="", res_id=0)` -> verified `sha256` and `size`.
Binding and access - Pass both `res_model` and `res_id` at commit time to bind the file to a business record. Access to the file then follows that record's ACL, so other users who can read the record can read the file. - Without a binding the file stays visible only to its creator and administrators. Never assume an unbound file is shared.
Download - `attachment_get_download_url(attachment_id)` -> a temporary `/web/content` URL. Fetch it with curl; the bytes do not travel through the tool channel. The URL is checked against the calling user's access at issuance time.
Limits - Upload URLs are single-use and expire after 1 hour. - An uncommitted staged attachment expires after 24 hours and is cleaned up. - Do not put file bytes or base64 in tool arguments.
